title: Entertainment Head End Chassis — Removal

issue.reason: Issue B. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Removal of the entertainment head end chassis from the equipment rack, with the cabin distribution isolated and the content media secured before the unit leaves the aircraft.

sections.purpose: This task gives the removal of the entertainment head end chassis from its rack in the galley area. Use it for unit replacement, for rack work, or before the feeder rework of the second generation installation.
sections.job_setup_note: Isolate the cabin entertainment distribution at the panel and put the warning notice on it. The chassis is heavy and sits above waist height, so two persons and the rack lifting handles are needed. If the operator holds content on the unit, the content must be secured through the operator's own procedure before power is removed; that is not part of this task but the aircraft must not be released without it.
sections.procedure: WARNING: ISOLATE THE CABIN ENTERTAINMENT DISTRIBUTION AT THE PANEL AND PUT THE WARNING NOTICE ON IT BEFORE YOU OPEN THE RACK. THE FEEDER IS LIVE WHENEVER GROUND POWER IS ON. Isolate the distribution and confirm that the rack is dead at the chassis connector. Open the galley access and remove the rack front cover. Release the galley insert at FIN 7RK6 and move it clear. Record the software part numbers reported by the unit before power was removed, if they were not recorded earlier. Disconnect the data and power connectors at the chassis and fit protective caps. CAUTION: DO NOT LIFT THE CHASSIS BY A CONNECTOR OR BY THE FRONT PANEL. USE THE LIFTING HANDLES ONLY. THE FRONT PANEL IS NOT A STRUCTURAL PART. Fit the rack lifting handles and release the chassis retainers. Slide the chassis out with two persons and put it on the transport trolley. Inspect the rack rails and the partition D4420121334529 for damage and report any finding. Fit the rack blanking panel if the chassis is not to be replaced immediately.
sections.close_out: Put the removed chassis on the transport trolley with its connector caps in place and its identification label completed. Leave the distribution isolated and the warning notice in place until the installation task is complete. Record the removal and the software part numbers in the aircraft technical log.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft. The retainer arrangement of the second generation chassis differs; use the second illustration.

safety_precautions: Isolate the cabin entertainment distribution and put the warning notice on the panel.
Confirm that the rack is dead at the chassis connector before you disconnect it.
Use two persons for the lift.
